report: Iteration 2 of PR #1887 (issue #1852, maintainer-only review-context-eval instrument). The iteration-1 Critical — four os.walk calls in lib/test/test_review_context_eval.py lacking the #711 `# tree-walk-ok:` marker — is CONFIRMED RESOLVED: markers added on lines 77/168/585/621, all four accurately describe their (non-repo-root) walk roots, and `python3 lib/test/lint-tree-enumeration.py` exits 0 (audited 170/170 files). The fix commit 8eafb1fd8 also made two comment/doc changes, both verified accurate and improving: (1) ENGINE_PREFIXES comment changed from 'longest prefix first' to 'disjoint — neither prefix contains the other' — the two prefixes ('skills/review-and-fix/','skills/review/') are genuinely disjoint (diverge at '/' vs '-'), so _engine_file_key correctness no longer depends on tuple order; (2) docs/internal/review-context.md dropped the transcribed '61,750-byte' literal to 'byte ceiling', removing a rot-prone checked-in figure per the anti-rot convention. Focused test passes (33 tests), ruff clean, coverage_map_guard OK, lint-reference-size OK. No NEW at-or-above-Important defect was introduced by the fix. Full Phase 3 roster (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, comment-analyzer, type-design-analyzer) dispatched in parallel; none returned a merge-blocking defect. All findings are Suggestions or a mitigated test-rigor nuance (below the fix threshold and not fix-introduced).
